variants.name: graceful-shutdown-verification
variants.description: Bounded server-full verification receipt for absolute shutdown deadlines, resource ownership, paired negative controls, and non-root container escalation margin

notes: Nine real-process shutdown controls pass, while the six intended baseline failures remain recorded.
MCP, live-query, A2A, ingestion, and embedded persistence ownership are exercised at their process boundaries.
The healthy non-root container exits 0 at 30,489 ms under the 30/35-second boundary with no SIGKILL.
The verification receipt is limited to server-full and explicitly leaves the parent 10,800-second certification pending.
No dependency or public Rust API is added.
